title: The Death of Europe's Last Electronics Giant
summary: TechAltar's history of Philips, once Europe's largest tech company and a world leader in lighting, radio and physical media. It traces how the company sold off or spun out its businesses, until little remains but the licensed name.
why: HN points to it when asked why many Philips-branded products aren't made by Philips, and for the company's decline.

quote.text: Techalter did a good job describing the fate of a lot of Philips different businesses and product lines.
